title: To Scrap Or To Scrub
summary:
Owners of older tankers face a dilemma
Tanker scrapping has been on an upswing this year and in a recent interview, an executive from the demolition industry highlighted the main drivers for demolition in the tanker industry: (the outlook for) freight rates, current scrap prices and the demolition activity in other shipping segments are always a factor. Regulatory changes can also be a driver, particularly if there are significant rule changes on the horizon. The phase out of single hull vessels in the period 1999-2003, for example, pushed up demolition levels during that period.
